findings.source_quote: He was at the crossroads, all his life as a whole.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «con toda su vida en juego» with wording that conveys that he had reached a crossroads in his life, for example: «Estaba en una encrucijada, en un momento decisivo de su vida.»
findings.translation_quote: Estaba en una encrucijada, con toda su vida en juego.

findings.source_quote: Than the almighty God. For all men it’s a must!
findings.suggested_fix: Make clear that putting one’s trust in God is a must for everyone, for example: «¡En el Dios todopoderoso, en quien todos deben confiar!»
findings.translation_quote: que el Dios todopoderoso. ¡Es imprescindible para todos!
